verdict.rationale: Mercury supports creating, sending, customizing, and tracking invoices at scale, including recurring invoices (docs-9, docs-14, docs-17), which covers the core invoicing and tracking-of-status story. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm online payment options on invoices or explicit read/paid receipt notifications (view/paid status tracking is implied by 'track' but not detailed), and no independent/hands-on corroboration exists. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of online payment collection method on invoices, explicit 'viewed' and 'paid' status notifications, independent verification beyond vendor docs.
